neighbours.label: a person's injury or death putting them out of action (out with a torn muscle, who died), against the same person in ordinary news
fire: The center is sidelined for a week with a sprained ankle.
The keeper is out for six weeks with a knee injury.
The old mayor, who died this morning, was 88.
Their coach, who died last spring, was beloved.
The key players got hurt, and the bench had to step up.
The goalie is hurt and it is not clear whether he will start.
After a fractured wrist, the guard is expected to sit.
The young pilot, who died at sea, was 24.
quiet: The center is in town to meet a new agent.
The keeper signed for six years at a new club.
The old mayor, who spoke this morning, was 88.
Their coach, who moved last spring, was beloved.
The key players got paid, and the bench stayed happy.
The goalie is ready and it is known that he will start.
After a fine season, the guard is expected to sign.
The young pilot, who flew at dawn, was 24.

notes: Peaks tend to fall on the token after the harm mention, and they are scattered. A non-injury 'out for a month with his family' also fired at 0.51 in probing, so this may be weak on absence alone.
